devdoc.details: The contract releases the ZKP tokens linearly to the PRP/ZKP pool. User who releases the ZKPs that surpasses a minimum reward threshold are rewarded with PRP tokens via the PRPVoucherGrantor contract.

params._owner: The address of the contract owner.
params._pantherPool: The address of the AMM contract to receive ZKP tokens.
params._zkpToken: The address of the ZKP token contract.

returns._0: uint64 The amount of ZKP tokens that can currently be released.

releaseZkps(bytes32).details: Calculates the releasable amount of tokens and sends them to the AMM. If the releasable amount is above the minimal rewarded amount, the user is rewarded with PRP tokens.

params.saltHash: A unique hash value used to distinguish between different refill actions.

rescueZkps(address,uint256).details: Allows the contract owner to rescue ZKP tokens from the contract. This function is intended for use in scenarios where tokens need to be recovered or reallocated. It is a safeguard to ensure that tokens can be retrieved in case they are sent to the contract by mistake or need to be moved for administrative reasons.

params.amount: The amount of ZKP tokens to rescue.
params.to: The address to which the ZKP tokens will be sent.

updateParams(uint256,uint256).details: Can only be called by the contract owner.

params.minRewardedAmount: The new minimum amount of ZKP tokens that need to be released to reward the user.
params.releasablePerBlock: The new amount of ZKP tokens that can be released per block.
